datasets.name: Loghub OpenSSH
datasets.publisher: LogPAI / Chinese University of Hong Kong (Loghub project)
datasets.associated_paper: He et al., Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics (arXiv:2008.06448)
datasets.version_identifier: Loghub OpenSSH (Zenodo record 1144100 family; OpenSSH subset documented in Loghub README)
datasets.license_notes: Loghub states datasets are free for research; citation of Loghub paper/repository required. Redistribution of full corpus not assumed unrestricted.
datasets.approx_size: ~70 MB (OpenSSH log file alone per Loghub documentation; full Loghub archive larger)
datasets.decision_reason: High OpenSSH host-log format similarity and SSH authentication event diversity, but no trustworthy NORMAL/SUSPICIOUS/BRUTE_FORCE ground truth. Suitable as parser-robustness / format-diversity corpus only; inventing labels from failure keywords is forbidden.

datasets.name: CIC-IDS2017
datasets.publisher: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC), University of New Brunswick
datasets.associated_paper: Sharafaldin, Lashkari, Ghorbani — Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization (ICISSP 2018)
datasets.license_notes: Available from UNB CIC for research; users must follow CIC dataset usage/citation terms. Redistribution of full dataset not assumed permitted.
datasets.approx_size: Multi-GB (PCAP + CSV; Tuesday SSH-Patator day is a large subset within full corpus)
datasets.decision_reason: Contains labeled SSH-Patator brute-force network traffic, but representation is PCAP/flow features—not host-side OpenSSH auth logs. Must not concatenate with P4 run-level host-log samples. Retain as separate network-domain reference / future multimodal experiment.

datasets.name: CAM-LDS (Cyber Attack Management - Linux Dataset)
datasets.publisher: AIT Austrian Institute of Technology / CAM-LDS authors (Zenodo)
datasets.associated_paper: CAM-LDS documentation / associated publications referenced on Zenodo record
datasets.platform: Linux system logs (multi-source including auth-related streams where present)
datasets.license_notes: Zenodo record provides CC-related / dataset license text; verify exact license file before any redistribution. Academic research use appears intended; redistribution restrictions may apply.
datasets.approx_size: Multi-GB archive family (full acquisition not justified for P5)
datasets.decision_reason: Linux security-log rich with MITRE ATT&CK technique labels and documented hydra-style brute-force scenarios, but label semantics are technique/scenario IDs—not NORMAL/SUSPICIOUS/BRUTE_FORCE. No lossy automatic mapping applied. Keep external for labeled comparison / future subset study; not direct supervised merge into P4 schema.

datasets.name: Loghub HDFS (rejected domain example)
datasets.license_notes: Same Loghub research-use framing; irrelevant to authentication domain.
datasets.decision_reason: Labeled but wrong domain: HDFS normal/anomaly is not Linux OpenSSH authentication behavior. Being labeled does not confer relevance. Documented as explicit rejection example.
